trigger.note: Wheel (ST2) is the collect settlement, opened by a scatter-pid trigger on the paid spin (ST1 carries payout_id 2021 with ReMarks='Trigger', pays 0 credits — a pure marker, not a win-bearing pid). Each trigger fires 1-3 sequential wheel spins (ST2 ReMarks='WheelSpin N', N=1..3); the wheel win settles in ST2.WinCredits, which has NO round-level PayoutId (synthesize_pay_id needed). Cadence is a scatter-pid trigger (~106 paid spins/trigger in the in-sample data), NOT a deterministic CollectCount metronome (contrast M279). No CellIndex in ST2.ReMarks -> no wheel_cells cell-map declaration (the per-round CellIndex landing map is absent on this machine; wheel_dynamics surfaces cadence/hit-rate/RTP-share from spin_type_breakdown and degrades gracefully on the missing cell map).

validation.evidence: Onboarded via fleet batch (manifest-only, no new code) 2026-06-18 on M94/mode_1 real chunks (_cache_version=3, provenance clean). ST inventory: ST1 (40000 rounds) = paid_spin/Normal (reel fields StopSymbolsByCol + PayoutByPayline + PayoutIdToWinAmount + cost>0; CurJackpotStoreWin present & =0 on 100%, test-interface-zeroed; ReMarks='Trigger' on 376 rounds = wheel trigger via pid 2021 which pays 0 / 376 rounds = pure marker, no double-count, WinCredits==sum(payid) on 100% of ST1 = no _unattributed_residual / no collect-coin channel: SymbolIndexToRewards/CollectCount/CreditsSymbols ALL ABSENT). ST2 (446 rounds) = settlement/Wheel: field signature EXACT-MATCHES M279 ST2 (bare WinCredits, no reels [StopSymbolsByCol=[]], no payid) -> STRICT-REUSE wheel_dynamics (play 'Wheel') + synthesize_pay_id rule (coordinator). ST2.ReMarks='WheelSpin 1/2/3' (a multi-step wheel index, NOT a CellIndex landing map) -> no wheel_cells block. Every ST1 Trigger round is immediately followed by ST2 (376/376). VALUE-AGNOSTIC: RTP not pinned.

Fleet-wide test-interface behavior (user-confirmed 2026-06-12 during M275 gate 8): a real progressive jackpot store that the CURRENT testspin interface forces to 0, so the sample correctly shows 0. Parse as-is (contributes 0 now); the field is already in the ST1 signature so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE when the interface is later optimized to populate it.
